title: Gorgeous Tumbler!
text: Gorgeous Tumbler!. This emerald green tumbler is gorgeous! It definitely reminds me of one you might find at the local SB coffee shop. It's sturdy. It keeps my water at a cool temperature for several hours. The texture makes it easy to hold and less likely to slip out of your hands.  I like it!
